description: PUCRS researchers collected ten-second polling-cycle records from a working smart-office room in Porto Alegre, Brazil. The Data in Brief article describes carbon dioxide, temperature, humidity, light and sound measurements, together with electrical power, voltage, current and device states from smart sockets, switches, an ESP32 node and a server. It also reports a human-verified count of occupants at each timestamp, checked against camera images after initial machine-detection suggestions. The current Zenodo record lists public CSV and JSON exports under CC BY 4.0; the article-cited older record redirects to this release. Coverage is one university room during routine operation, not a representative building stock or a synchronized instrument array. All values in one record share an end-of-cycle timestamp but may have been polled at different instants within the ten-second window. Device outages, access rules and manually corrected occupancy labels may affect model transfer. A reviewer-assessed use is calibrating occupancy-responsive lighting, ventilation or plug-load simulations. model-energyplus and data-refit-smart-homes-uk are related building resources, but no import or cross-building comparison was made. The release lists two data files; raw camera images are not listed. No data file or article PDF was downloaded.
